name: oneirloom
description: Visual prompting, reference analysis, craft construction, digital form, spatial concepts, and result diagnosis with 23 source skills.

interface.longDescription: Oneirloom 0.3.1-preview contains 23 skills for visual prompts, reference analysis, craft construction, digital form, space conception, composition and light, model adaptation, and result diagnosis. Use an image-capable host for visual analysis and a separately configured image model or tool for generation. The optional prompt-card renderer uses local Python, Pillow and Playwright. No MCP server, account connection, background service or automatic upload is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Use Oneirloom to turn this visual idea into a complete image prompt.
Analyze this reference image with Oneirloom before writing the prompt.
Compare this image result with my intended composition and revise the prompt.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.1-preview source preview contains 23 skills. Fixed package availability and its exact inventory are recorded in the release metadata. Six inspected teaching examples retain their passed, partial and failed observations.
